title: Closeout summary: T2 Drop context packs/chunks from search corpus
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Dropped derived context_pack/context_chunk documents from the search corpus. buildSearchEntries now indexes only primary records, readSearchSnapshot no longer loads or synthesizes context packs, context search queries primary records, and handoff search no longer special-cases context chunks. Dogfood search-index.json rebuilt from 46M to 14M with 1308 documents and no context document types.

Close reason: T2 acceptance satisfied: search index contains only primary records, context_pack/context_chunk types are removed, dogfood index size recorded at 14M, and check/test/sync/doctor verification passed.
